messages:
Dana C.: Announcement: SLO threshold deprecation + blackout window on Tue 2026-05-05 23:30-00:30 UTC. We're retiring legacy route-level SLOs in favor of new per-model SLOs. This requires a short config push and a small canary mini-loadtest. Hosted API unaffected for traffic routed via public pool; Dedicated in ap-northeast-1 will be in-scope.

Ravi P.: What should teams expect? Any alerts fired? :eyes:

Dana C.: Alerts for affected routes will be muted during the 1h window; we will still emit metrics. Expected impact: transient p95/p99 blips for bulk traffic, negligible for paid tiers. Rollout is non-disruptive by design; will run one canary at 23:35 UTC targeting 2% traffic then expand.

OpsBot: Maintenance ticket created: https://internal/maintenance/2311112222 state: scheduled owner: @Dana C. notify: oncall slack_channel: #eng-sre

Oncall Mei: I'll take watch. Pre-ops checklist: confirm PagerDuty mapping to SLO-Config-PD, prewarm top prefixes, ensure replicas < 200ms lag.

Dana C.: Rollout rules (short):
```
- Wave0 23:35 UTC: 2% traffic, 10m observe
- Wave1 23:50 UTC: 8% traffic, 10m observe
- Expand 00:10 UTC if no rollback
- Auto-rollback: error_rate > 0.5% for 2m OR p99 > 2s for 3m
```

Ravi P.: Can we exclude enterprise orgs? I'll DM the org-ids now.

Oncall Mei: I'll enable 5% TRACE sampling if p99 > 1s and post short statuses here (started / wave0 OK / wave1 rollback / done). Keeping chatter out of observe windows.

Dana C.: Post-run we'll publish a short summary and note any SLO mapping changes in the runbook. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
